scientific_integrity.claim: For zero-initialized scalar OU diffusion on the unit interval, integrated posterior path variance under one noisy point measurement has a globally unique optimal time, strictly past the midpoint but before a finite rate-dependent interior limiting site; optimum rises strictly with noise.
limitations: Known covariance parameters; one observation; unweighted integrated posterior variance; unit time interval.
No result for stationary or random initial conditions, multiple observations, or weighted time-risk.
First public date concerns the dated 2016 reference used for the focal trajectory-design framework, not publication of this finding.
Publication priority remains subject to undetected equivalents; independent mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_integrity.verification: Symbolic covariance identities plus analytic sign proof and independent numerical quadrature tests.

title: A unique noise-monotone observation time for a zero-initialized Ornstein–Uhlenbeck trajectory
